lifecycle.faultFixtures: Owner transfer and edge revocation use exact stopped-H2 updates. All source creation, ordinary correction/deletion, association creation and post-restart reads use authenticated HTTP.

scoring.unit: Returned evidence and API abstention only. No generated answer is scored.
scoring.answerEvidence: All required source keys and the exact answer text occur in a disclosed context.
scoring.precision: Disclosed relevant keys divided by all disclosed keys, reported per case.
scoring.abstention: A required-abstention case discloses no context/items/page and answerPolicy is not ALLOW_ANSWER.
scoring.latency: Python monotonic elapsed time for one authenticated compile HTTP request. Seven measured repetitions after two warmups, same process and fixture.
scoring.tokens: Server tokenEstimate and actual UTF-8 context bytes. This compiler uses a conservative byte ceiling, not a model tokenizer.
